claims.label: Andrew Kolvet denied divorce rumor via social media
claims.claim: Andrew Kolvet publicly denied divorce rumors via X post, telling Project Constitution "LOL, you wish, fat boy" and instructing them to keep his wife's name out of their mouth.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the exact wording of Kolvet's post and timestamp against X archives; identify whether any divorce filings exist in Arizona court records.

claims.label: Project Constitution reported Andrew Kolvet divorce rumor
claims.claim: An X account identifying as Project Constitution reported that Andrew Kolvet was getting a divorce.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the author and posting history of the Project Constitution account; obtain the original post content and any cited basis.

claims.label: Tyler Bowyer accused rumor-mongers of "reckless disregard for truth"
claims.claim: Tyler Bowyer publicly stated he has had "numerous things like this said about us" and characterized such reporting as "reckless disregard for truth from people who call themselves investigators."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the original X post and any subsequent posts by Bowyer; cross-reference his stated history of false rumors.

claims.label: Blake Neff defended Andrew Kolvet's WHCD absence
claims.claim: Per posts by Blake Neff that the host reads, he publicly disputed the implication that Andrew Kolvet's wife was absent from the White House Correspondents Dinner, arguing that WHCD attendance requires press-issued invitations, that Kolvet lives in Phoenix, and questioning how anyone would know his wife's travel preferences.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the original post; check WHCD invitation lists if publicly available.

claims.label: Donors present in Aspen assert Charlie Kirk's "I appoint my wife" audio was faked
claims.claim: Per Candace, donors who were present at the Aspen event assert that the TPUSA-released audio of Charlie Kirk saying "I appoint my wife to run Turning Point USA if something happens to me" was faked, and that the moment never happened. Candace states this report has been on the desk for 39 days as of this episode.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the specific donors by name; obtain written or recorded statements; secure the original unedited audio if TPUSA retains it; obtain independent audio-forensic analysis of the released clip.

claims.label: Released audio clip contains Charlie Kirk saying "I appoint my wife to run Turning Point USA"
claims.claim: The audio clip released by Turning Point USA contains Charlie Kirk stating three times "I appoint my wife to run Turning Point USA if something happens to me. Erika would do a great job."
claims.investigative_direction: Locate TPUSA's original release of the clip; obtain timestamped metadata; compare against any verified recordings of Charlie Kirk's voice.

claims.label: Marcus Wada provides AI voice services for TPUSA presentations
claims.claim: Per a source who came forward, Turning Point USA employee Marcus Wada offers AI voice generation services for TPUSA presentations.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Wada's TPUSA employment and the scope of his AI services; identify any other clients or projects; obtain a sample of his AI-generated voice work.

claims.label: TPUSA typically uses AI-cloned voice of Pastor John Amanchukwu in presentations
claims.claim: Per the source, Turning Point USA presentations typically feature AI-generated voice-over using Pastor John Amanchukwu's voice (described as with his permission).
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain a TPUSA presentation featuring the contested voice; verify with Pastor Amanchukwu whether he consented to voice cloning; secure source's full statement.

claims.label: John Mappin publicly shared Aspen donor's claim the audio moment never happened
claims.claim: John Mappin shared on X that an Aspen donor told him the moment depicted in the audio never happened.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Mappin's original X post and identify the donor he referenced; obtain Mappin's full statement.

claims.label: Kimberly Klacik publicly questioned why the audio matters
claims.claim: Kimberly Klacik publicly argued on X that since the TPUSA board elected Erika Kirk as CEO and no donors had publicly questioned the decision, the authenticity of the audio does not matter.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the original post; obtain TPUSA board meeting minutes documenting Erika's CEO election.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Kirk Received Honorary Doctorate from Hillsdale College
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk delivered the Hillsdale College commencement address and was awarded an honorary doctorate.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Hillsdale College's official press release or commencement program; verify the date and the credentials cited for the award.

claims.label: Brian Allen publicly characterized Hillsdale's honorary doctorate for Erika as DEI
claims.claim: Brian Allen publicly argued on X that Hillsdale College awarding Erika Kirk an honorary doctorate and commencement platform contradicts Hillsdale's stated anti-DEI position, characterizing the decision as "Diversity, equity and inclusion for me and not for thee."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the original post; cross-reference Hillsdale's public statements on DEI.

claims.label: Erika Kirk's old LinkedIn claimed ASU magna cum laude graduation
claims.claim: Erika Kirk's older LinkedIn page (since removed) stated she graduated from Arizona State University magna cum laude, in connection with a Great American Race audition video.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain archived versions of the LinkedIn page (Wayback Machine or other captures); verify against ASU graduation records.

claims.label: Host Alleges Erika Kirk's LinkedIn Was Upgraded to Claim Summa Cum Laude with Double Degree
claims.claim: The host alleges that Erika Kirk later upgraded her LinkedIn page, shown by the host as an old version since removed, to state she graduated summa cum laude with a double degree in political science and international relations.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain archived LinkedIn captures showing both versions; verify degree titles and honors with ASU registrar.

claims.label: ASU did not offer international relations degree in 2012
claims.claim: Per Baron Coleman and other online researchers, Arizona State University did not offer an international relations degree program at all in 2012, when Erika Kirk claims to have graduated.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain ASU's archived 2012 course catalog directly from the university or library archives; verify the degree offerings list.

claims.label: Host Alleges Erika Kirk's LinkedIn Claimed Doctor of Education from Liberty University
claims.claim: The host alleges that Erika Kirk's LinkedIn page lists a Doctor of Education in Christian Leadership from Liberty University, which the host says she did not actually earn (she took only a couple of credits toward the goal).
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Liberty's Ed.D. in Christian Leadership program; obtain Liberty's records on Erika Kirk's actual enrollment.

claims.label: Host Says Nick Shirley Video Claimed He Infiltrated Brazilian Gang in 48 Hours
claims.claim: The host says Nick Shirley is associated with a video claiming he infiltrated the most dangerous gang in Brazil within 48 hours.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original favela video; verify any corroborating evidence (local news, authorities, contacts).

claims.label: Patrick Bet-David hosted Nick Shirley and discussed Candace's prior skepticism
claims.claim: Patrick Bet-David's show hosted Nick Shirley, during which Shirley stated that Candace Owens "came after me uh a while back" and didn't believe his Brazilian favela video; Bet-David asked "Why would Candace Owens come after you?"
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full PBD interview clip and timestamp; verify PBD's framing of prior coverage.

claims.label: Alex Clark publicly defended Nick Shirley against Candace Owens
claims.claim: Alex Clark publicly wrote on X: "Nick Shirley is a real journalist. Candace Owens is not."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the original post and Alex Clark's relationship with Nick Shirley.

claims.label: Brian Harpole's alibi flights were 1:49 PM Dallas to Salt Lake City on the 9th
claims.claim: According to flight records shown to Candace during her private interview with Erika, Brian Harpole's alibi flights on the 9th departed Dallas at 1:49 PM for Salt Lake City – a window that does not cover the morning timeframe when Mitch reported seeing him at Fort Huachuca.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the flight records independently through airline records or TSA; obtain Brian Harpole's full itinerary for the date in question.

claims.label: Fort Huachuca alibi photograph was provided by Andrew Kolvet
claims.claim: A photograph allegedly depicting Erika Kirk with her children at Fort Huachuca was provided to online defenders by Andrew Kolvet, with the explicit instruction "don't share."
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original alibi photo and Andrew Kolvet's accompanying message; verify provenance.

claims.label: Paramount Tactical admitted the Fort Huachuca alibi photo boy is not Erika Kirk's son
claims.claim: Paramount Tactical admitted over the weekend that the boy depicted in the Fort Huachuca alibi photograph is not Erika Kirk's son; a source close to the family reportedly says the child is neither of Erika's children.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Paramount Tactical's specific admission statement; identify the actual child in the photo.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet coordinated the Harpole alibi pushback with Paramount Tactical and Valhalla
claims.claim: Per host, Andrew Kolvet was the coordinator behind the Paramount Tactical and Valhalla YouTube efforts to push back on the Fort Huachuca allegations against Brian Harpole, despite Erika's claim that Kolvet was being moved off of PR responsibilities.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain direct evidence of coordination (emails, DMs, communications); obtain statement from Kolvet, Paramount Tactical, and Valhalla.

claims.label: Erika Kirk provided Candace with Brian Harpole's alibi during their private interview
claims.claim: During Candace's private interview with Erika Kirk, Erika volunteered Brian Harpole's flight records as his alibi – which Candace notes did not actually cover the timeframe of Mitch's sighting.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Candace's documented record of the interview; verify the flight records independently.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Said She Needed to Go Home Before Appearing at Hillsdale
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk had said she wanted to go home and the audience endured a lecture about her needing to be home with her family, yet she then went to Michigan to give the Hillsdale College commencement speech.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Erika Kirk's earlier public statements about going home to her family and compare them with the Hillsdale College commencement schedule.
claims.transcript_snippet: after saying she wanted to go home, us enduring a lecture about how she needed to go home to her family, she bounced over to to Michigan

claims.label: Host Says Erika Cited Fear of Flying and Secret Service Gaps but Now Has No Secret Service
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk has been described as too scared to get on a plane by herself and as unprotectable by the Secret Service, and that she now has no Secret Service while appearing on stage at a school.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Erika Kirk's own statements on her protection status and any Secret Service or private security arrangements for the Hillsdale event.
claims.transcript_snippet: She's too scared to get on a plane by herself. Secret Service can't protect her. Oh, now she doesn't have Secret Service, and she's back on stage at a school, nonetheless.

claims.label: Neff Replied to Project Constitution That It Was Not Very Smart
claims.claim: The host reads a post in which Blake Neff replied to Project Constitution, writing that it is not very smart.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull Blake Neff's X reply to Project Constitution and confirm its wording, time and the post it answered.
claims.transcript_snippet: Blake Neff jumped in. He wrote back to Project Constitution, you are not very smart, are you?

claims.label: Host Says She Never Heard Kolvet Was Divorcing
claims.claim: The host says she has never heard that Andrew Kolvet is divorcing his wife and that rumors like this surface about public figures about once a week.
claims.investigative_direction: Check Arizona court records for any divorce filing and the original Project Constitution post; this is a personal matter and the host only reports her own awareness.
claims.transcript_snippet: by the way have never heard that Andrew Kolvet is divorcing his wife.

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Refuses to Release the Video of the Appointment Moment
claims.claim: The host says Turning Point USA is refusing to release video of the moment in which Charlie Kirk says he appoints his wife, and has not authoritatively responded that the donors are lying.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask TPUSA for the original camera footage and metadata of the Aspen presentation and whether any video of the statement exists.
claims.transcript_snippet: Turning Point for some reason is refusing to drop the video of that moment saying this of Charlie saying this.

claims.label: Host Says Neff Worried People Would Call the Video AI
claims.claim: The host says Blake Neff specifically expressed concern that if TPUSA released the video people would say it is AI.
claims.investigative_direction: Find Blake Neff's own public or private statement expressing this concern, including its date and audience.
claims.transcript_snippet: Blake has specifically expressed concern, you will recall, that if they do drop it, people will say it's AI.

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Itself Pointed Her Team to the Video
claims.claim: The host says Turning Point USA itself mentioned the appointment video to her team.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify who at TPUSA mentioned the video to the host's team, when, and in what message or call.
claims.transcript_snippet: the video, which I would like to point out, Turning Point USA mentioned this video to us.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Told Megyn Kelly an Emotional Story About First Watching the Video
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk told Megyn Kelly an emotional story about what it felt like to watch the video of Charlie choosing her for the first time.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the Megyn Kelly interview with Erika Kirk for her account of watching the video and compare it with any released footage.
claims.transcript_snippet: Erika herself told Megyn Kelly an emotional story about what she felt like watching that video for the first time

claims.label: Host Says the Appointment Contradicts Charlie's Public Statements About Women Working
claims.claim: The host says that Charlie choosing his wife violates every public statement he had made about women working and is a complete reversal of his prior positions.
claims.investigative_direction: Compile Charlie Kirk's recorded statements on women and work and compare them with the appointment statement.
claims.transcript_snippet: violating suddenly his every public statement and sentiment that he had ever expressed in the past about women working, complete 180 from his prior positions.

claims.label: Host Calls Marcus Wada a Former Arms Dealer Now at TPUSA
claims.claim: The host describes Marcus Wada as a Turning Point employee who is a former arms dealer.
claims.investigative_direction: Review Wada's own TPUSA biography, his LinkedIn and any reporting on his past arms-related work to confirm the description.
claims.transcript_snippet: the Turning Point employee that's a rehabilitated former arms dealer.

claims.label: Host Says John Mappin Introduced Charlie to His Biggest Donor
claims.claim: The host says John Mappin is the person who introduced Charlie Kirk to his biggest donor.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask John Mappin or TPUSA donor records who the largest donor is and who made the introduction.
claims.transcript_snippet: John Mappin, who is the person who introduced Charlie to actually his biggest donor.

claims.label: Host Says the Biggest Donor Was First on the List Called From the Hospital
claims.claim: The host says Charlie Kirk's biggest donor was first in line on a list of donors who received personal phone calls from the hospital on the day Charlie died.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the donor call list and call records from the hospital day and identify who placed each call.
claims.transcript_snippet: A donor so big that that donor was first in line on a list of donors who received personal phone calls from the hospital the day that Charlie died.

claims.label: Host Describes Erika Walking Out at AmFest to Charlie's Voice in a Glittering Pantsuit
claims.claim: Describing a hypothetical in which the audio was AI, the host recounts that at AmFest Charlie's recorded voice passed the company to Erika while she wore a glittering pantsuit with fireworks behind her.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the AmFest 2025 stream and program for the audio cue, who cleared it, and its source file.
claims.transcript_snippet: "The company is mine at Amfest while she wore glittering pants, glittering pant plant pantsuit and had fireworks going on behind her.

claims.label: Host Says Neff's Subway Killer Scenario Is TPUSA's Reason for Not Releasing the Video
claims.claim: The host says Blake Neff's subway killer scenario is the stated reason Turning Point USA will not release the video.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Blake Neff's original subway comparison and any TPUSA statement tying it to the non-release of the video.
claims.transcript_snippet: you guys can take your bets on whether you believe Blake Neff and his uh Subway killer scenario as the reason they won't release the video.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Accepted a Posthumous Honorary Doctorate for Charlie
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk accepted a posthumous honorary doctorate on behalf of Charlie Kirk, in addition to one for herself.
claims.investigative_direction: Check Hillsdale College's commencement announcement for the list of honorary degrees conferred.
claims.transcript_snippet: she accepted a posthumous doctorate degree for Charlie uh honorary doctorate and also an honorary doctorate for herself.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Auditioned for the Great American Race With an Ex-Boyfriend
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk tried out for The Great American Race with an ex-boyfriend despite having said she had no boyfriend in the five years before Charlie.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the audition video and any Erika Kirk interviews on her dating history to compare the statements.
claims.transcript_snippet: when she was trying out for the American race with her ex-boyfriend, she never said, you know, she never had a boyfriend before Charlie in the five years before Charlie, but she did.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Claimed ASU Magna Cum Laude in Her Audition Video
claims.claim: The host says that in the video Erika Kirk submitted for The Great American Race she said she graduated from ASU magna cum laude.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the audition video and ASU's records of degree and honors conferred on Erika Kirk.
claims.transcript_snippet: when they were trying out for the Great American Race in the video that she submitted, she said that she graduated from ASU magna laude.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Graduated With No Honors and No Double Degree
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk did not graduate magna cum laude or summa cum laude, graduated with no honors and did not earn a double degree.
claims.investigative_direction: Request ASU's degree verification (National Student Clearinghouse) and the commencement program for Erika Kirk's class.
claims.transcript_snippet: she didn't graduate magna laude and she also didn't graduate summa laude. She didn't graduate with any honors and she did not graduate with a double degree.

claims.label: Host Says the Inflated Credentials Were Put in Official Bios
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk's inflated credentials were put in bios and were not a single mistake by an intern.
claims.investigative_direction: Collect archived TPUSA and third-party bios of Erika Kirk and date each claimed credential.
claims.transcript_snippet: she's put it on bios, so this is not like, oh, this was one mistake and I had an intern that typed a button wrong.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Did Receive a Master's From Liberty University Online
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk did receive a master's degree from Liberty University online.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the master's degree and field with Liberty University's registrar or degree verification service.
claims.transcript_snippet: she did receive her master's um from Liberty University online

claims.claim: The host says the Bride of Charlie series did not cover that Erika Kirk's whole educational background was made up, because there were too many lies to include.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the Bride of Charlie episodes with the later credential claims to confirm the topic was not covered.

claims.transcript_snippet: like he's this the term that they use here is fed jacketed. Like essentially, he's being created by the media.

claims.claim: The host says she covered the person on her September 10 show while working through timelines, made a mistake that she owned, and spoke with him right after the assassination.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the host's September 10 show and her follow-up conversation with the person for what was said and corrected.
claims.transcript_snippet: That's the reason I covered him on the show on September 10th when I was trying to work through timelines and I made a mistake.

claims.label: Host Says Shirley Is Known for Uncovering Somali Daycare Welfare Fraud

claims.investigative_direction: Review the Minnesota daycare fraud reporting and the charging records that followed.
claims.transcript_snippet: they say, Nick Fuentes has uncovered massive welfare fraud in the Somalian community in Minnesota.
